description: Prepare a price, indicator, chart-drawing, news, calendar or Founder whale-group alert and get a link that sets it in Basis in one click. Use it whenever the person wants to be told when something happens -- a level breaks, RSI crosses 70, price crosses a trend line, a high-impact ETF headline lands, or an event approaches. Pass exactly one of price, conditions, drawingId or eventTrigger. Give the URL as a link and say in one line what it watches. Nothing is armed until they open it and confirm. Market alerts can run in an open tab; background and event alerts require a signed-in Basis account. The link lasts seven days.

conditions.description: Instead of price. Each {left, operator, right}. An operand is a number, a price field ("close"), an indicator name ("rsi", "ema50"), or {"type":"indicator","studyId":"macd","plotKey":"histogram","params":{}}. rising and falling need no right; changeUpPercent and changeDownPercent take a percent.

drawingId.description: ID returned by drawing_add. Supports horizontalLine, horizontalRay, trendLine, ray and extendedLine.

eventTrigger.description: Instead of market conditions. A news, Basis calendar or Founder whale-group event filter.

assets.description: News asset symbols, e.g. BTC, ETH.

coins.description: Whale: exact Hyperliquid coins, preserving HIP-3 prefixes.

keywords.description: News: literal phrases in title or summary.

leadMinutes.description: Calendar: notify this many minutes before the event.

minImpact.description: News: 0-100 score. Calendar: low, medium or high.

minUsd.description: Whale minimum absolute position change notional; default 50000.

together.description: Distinct accounts moving on the same coin and side. Default 1.

whales.description: Founders only: opaque account IDs from founder_whales or founder_whale_research.

frequency.description: Default once: fires, then switches itself off.

message.description: Optional note carried into the notification.

name.description: What the person sees when it fires. Chosen for you if omitted.

symbol.description: e.g. BTCUSDT. Defaults to the chart you are building.

timeframe.description: Bars the alert is checked on. Free presets: 1m, 3m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 3d, 1w, 1M. Founder-only custom intervals: 1–1440 minutes (17m), 1–168 hours (7h), 1–365 days (2d).

when.description: With price. Omit to pick the crossing from where price is now.

name: alert_link
